newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan victim of Paris bomb buried.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan victim of Paris bomb buried.

text.p: A Moroccan student who died from wounds received in the bomb attack on a Paris city train earlier this month was buried on Friday in Rabat.
The official news agency MAP said French ambassador Michel de Bonnecorse joined relatives and Moroccan officials for the funeral of Younes Nait Slimane, 28, who died on Sunday in a Paris hospital.
Four people, including another Moroccan, were killed in the December 3 blast that police suspect was set by Algerian Moslem fundamentalists.
